clips.title: The story
paras: At Dolanaar, Rare Earth waits for delivery to Denalan's camp near Lake Al'Ameth. The mineral-rich soil came from Darnassus for his botanical experiments on Teldrassil.

Rare Earth is late reaching Dolanaar from Darnassus. Denalan, an eccentric botanist on Lake Al'Ameth's eastern shore, requested the parcel to study plants in Teldrassil's young ecosystem. Herbalist Syral Bladeleaf now entrusts the soil to travelers heading south, hoping it reaches Denalan before its potency fades.
